title: 4.7 Simple Present
unit_outcome: Locate familiar things and describe a short supported routine using known subjects, simple present chunks, days, and clock times.
goal: Generalize familiar routine chunks across I, you, we, and they and mark repeated routine with every day.
grammar_function: I/you/we/they + base verb for routine. First and then link two known actions. No he/she third-person -s and no do/does negatives/questions.
prerequisite: 4.5-4.6 first-person routine chunks and 3.2 plural speaker pronouns.
speaking_outcome: Repeat four habitual simple-present sentences and two ordered First/Then statements.
